outcome: The owner's local n8n agent read execution #260 node by node. This is the first per-node token measurement this project has: the webhook reply carries no usage, and every earlier estimate was built from one recorded total.

totals.why: Measured at the nodes, not at the webhook. No dollar figure: the rates for this model at this date are not established here, and inventing one would be worse than saying so. The three collection agents carry high cached_tokens because the system prompt is reused and billed at a reduced rate; root-cause has none, so its 3915 are at full price.

notes: The four Ask nodes are HTTP Request nodes, not OpenAI nodes: the model is a literal string in the JSON body, generated by scripts/generate-workflow.mjs.

The same credential has access to gpt-4o, gpt-4.1 and the gpt-5 family. So every result measured so far - five of six right code, the citation never given - is the behaviour of a MINI model, and that is an explanation nobody has excluded.
The payload reaches the model whole: 14 configuration entries, finish_reason stop, no truncation anywhere between the Code node and the model.
